text:
maya: Heads-up — I'm going to run a targeted throughput probe on cb tuning for the 30B quantized variant in staging. Can folks check the schedule window and let me know if there are any competing runs?

sam: Thanks — what's the exact config you're testing (max_batch, max_tokens, queue_window)?

maya: Plan is: max_batch=48, max_tokens=2048, queue_window=12ms, and target steady-state arrival ~220 req/s. Using continuous-batching enabled and prefix caching off for the first pass.

juan: 220 req/s sounds high for that batch size on the 1xA100 pool. Did you mean burst target? Also which model variant tag?

maya: Good call — it's a staged burst -> steady plan. Burst to 350 for 30s then settle at 220. Variant tag: rdx-30b-8bit-q4_0-prod-cb1.

ciara: I'll have loadgen reserved at 20:00 PT for 45m. There's a long-running eval job on the same cluster ending at 19:50 PT. That should be fine.

maya: Awesome, thanks @ciara. Bench command I plan to run:
```
./loadgen --target 220 --burst 350 --model rdx-30b-8bit-q4_0 --max-batch 48 --max-tokens 2048 --queue-window-ms 12 --out /tmp/cb-1934567890.json
```

sam: Can you add the exact perf metrics you'll collect? We want p50/p90/p99 latency, tokens/s, and batch size histogram. Also tag run with `cb-tuning-1934567890` in the metadata.

maya: Will do. I'll upload artifacts to the perf bucket and link PR for the analysis notebook.

bench-bot: Reservation acknowledged: loadgen node booked for maya at 20:00 PT (45m). Tag `cb-tuning-1934567890` created.

juan: FYI I'll shadow the run and start a lightweight profiler on one replica to capture kernel timings. If p99 > 600ms we should reduce max_batch to 32 and re-run.

ciara: Noted. Also add a regression check step: after the run, compare with baseline run `cb-baseline-1865123456` for throughput and qps-per-GPU.

maya: Good idea. I'll include baseline diff in the notebook and highlight any >10% regressions.

sam: Quick code-review ping: I opened a tiny PR to log queue-window in the request tracing headers (PR #4823). If you can review before the run that'd help tie traces to loadgen config.

maya: Reviewing now, will merge if green.

ciara: If merged, I'll trigger the run and watch dashboards. :eyes:

maya: Merge done, artifacts path will be gs://redwood-perf/cb/1934567890/*. I'll post links after upload.

juan: Great. If anything odd pops up, @maya please keep the run so we can reproduce.

maya: Copy. Will keep raw logs and KV cache dumps. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
